referenceSources.description:
John Marcar’s white BMW Z3 M Coupe tears around the Goodwood race circuit during the Mission Motorsport 7th Anniversary event on 2nd March 2017. The car’s distinctive wide fenders, tow hook, and “BMW Japan” windshield banner stand out against the lush green grass bordering the tarmac. Captured by Chris McEvoy (Media ID 18815672), this image highlights the blend of classic sports car styling and high-speed track action.

Available through CJM Photography, this shot can be purchased as framed prints, canvas prints, poster prints, jigsaw puzzles, and metal prints. The photograph supports The Forces Motorsport Charity’s Race, Retrain, Recover program and is part of a broader motorsport archive showcasing fast cars and racing circuits in West Sussex, England.
